title: Departure Of R.I. Bodnek, Soviet Official

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 21, 6-1-3

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI
C. & Section 2. Station.
No. S. C. D. 2407.
Date July 6, 1931.
ate 7 - 7 - 31

Subject (in full) Departure of R. I. Bodnek. Soviet Official.

Made by D. S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

The undermentioned Soviet citizen left Shanghai for
Changchun on July 5, 1931 by the s.s. Dairen Maru.

R. I. Bodnek. Reported to be Vice-Director i/c
of the Commercial Department of
the ALLTEXPORT, USSR. He is native
of Riga, 35 years of age, married,
and holds passport No. 200264/21055
issued by the People's Commissariat
of Interior, Moscow on April 8th,
1931.
On May 18, 1931 he applied to the
local Japanese Consulate for a
visa to enable him to proceed to
Japan on a business tour. For
reasons so far unknown, this was
not granted.
While in Shanghai he resided at
455 Rue Lafayette, apt. No. 17

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Reg. Copy and unusual authority.
Please file.
[Signature]
7/7/31
Copy sent to Mr. S.
[Signature]
7/7

BODNEK, R. I. - Soviet
Vice-Director of Commercial Dept. of NEFTEAFORT, USSR.
Holds passport No. 200264/21055
In Shanghai resided at 455 Rue Lafayette, Apt. 17.

SMF: No. S.D. D 2407
